ingredient_groups.title: The Chicken & Marinade
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Chicken pieces**: 2–3 whole leg quarters or equivalent pieces ([**0:35**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=35s))
- **Gochujang (Korean red pepper paste)**: A generous dollop ([**0:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=48s))
- **Yellow mustard**: A squeeze (standard hot dog style) ([**1:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=61s))
- **Sweet pickle juice**: A splash ([**0:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=48s))
- **Cornstarch**: A handful to bind the marinade ([**1:01**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=61s))
- **Seasoning baseline**: A pinch of ginger powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and white pepper ([**0:54**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=54s))

ingredient_groups.title: The Crispy Batter Coating
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Potato starch**: 150 g
- **Cornstarch**: 30 g
- **All-purpose flour**: 30 g
- **Tapioca starch**: 30 g
- **Baking soda**: 7 g
- **Eggs**: 2 large
- **Spices**: 29.5 mL each of ginger powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and white pepper

ingredient_groups.title: The Sticky Glaze Sauce
ingredient_groups.body:
- **Garlic**: 3 cloves (pressed)
- **Vegetable oil**: 29.5 mL
- **Ketchup**: 80 g
- **Rice syrup**: 105 g *(Crucial ingredient for an authentic gloss)* ([**10:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=628s))
- **Apple cider vinegar**: 32 g
- **Gochujang (Korean red pepper paste)**: 60 g
- **Soy sauce**: 18 g
- **Sugar**: 18 g [[1](https://youtu.be/F1Bm01fBBpo#:~:text=Join%20our%20chef%20in%20the%20kitchen%20for,easy%20recipe%20for%20a%20truly%20fantastic%20meal.)]

steps.title: 1. Marinate the Chicken
steps.body:
- Place your chicken pieces into a large bowl ([**0:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=20s)). Coat them entirely with gochujang, yellow mustard, sweet pickle juice, a handful of cornstarch, and a light sprinkling of your ginger powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and white pepper ([**0:48**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=48s)). Massage the flavor deeply into the meat and let it rest ([**0:20**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=20s)).  
  *Pro-Tip: Do not skip the marinade! This step infuses structural juiciness and deep flavor directly into the meat grains so the chicken tastes excellent even without sauce (*[***1:47***](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=107s)*).*

steps.title: Step 2: Add the Egg Binder
steps.body: - Crack 2 large eggs directly into your marinated chicken bowl. Mix them entirely by hand until every piece of meat is slick, slippery, and fully covered in a wet glaze ([**1:24**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=84s)). [[1](https://youtu.be/F1Bm01fBBpo#:~:text=Join%20our%20chef%20in%20the%20kitchen%20for,easy%20recipe%20for%20a%20truly%20fantastic%20meal.)]

steps.title: Step 3: Whisk the Dry Dredge
steps.body: - In a clean, dry bowl, weigh out 150 g of potato starch, 30 g of cornstarch, 30 g of all-purpose flour, and 30 g of tapioca starch. Whisk in 7 g of baking soda along with 29.5 mL each of ginger powder, garlic powder, onion powder, and white pepper. Blend this flour combination thoroughly until uniform ([**4:23**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=263s)).

steps.title: Step 4: Dredge and Rest the Chicken
steps.body: - Take one wet chicken piece at a time and drop it into the dry dredge mixture ([**5:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=311s)). Press the dry powder firmly and patiently into every single crevice of the meat to guarantee massive crunch coverage ([**5:11**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=311s)). Lay the coated chicken on a clean surface and let it rest for a few minutes while you bring your frying oil up to heat ([**5:30**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=330s)).

steps.title: Step 5: The First Fry
steps.body: - Drop the rested chicken carefully into a pot of clean hot cooking oil. Fry for exactly 7 minutes ([**6:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=396s)). This initial blast crisps up the outer starches and locks the exterior framework into place ([**9:06**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=546s)). Remove the chicken and let it rest briefly.

steps.title: Step 6: The Second Fry
steps.body: - Drop the chicken pieces back into the hot oil for a secondary fry lasting another 7 minutes ([**6:36**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=396s)). *Do not skip this step!* This second deep fry forces deep pocket moisture out of the interior flesh, ensuring the coating remains insanely crunchy even after it gets doused in sticky sauce ([**9:14**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=554s)).

steps.title: Step 7: Build the Glaze Sauce
steps.body: - In a saucepan over medium heat, sauté 3 pressed garlic cloves in 29.5 mL of vegetable oil. Whisk in 80 g of ketchup, 105 g of rice syrup, 32 g of apple cider vinegar, 60 g of gochujang, 18 g of soy sauce, and 18 g of sugar. Whisk continuously until the mixture comes to a gentle simmer and glazes into a shiny, unified sauce ([**11:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=688s)).

steps.title: Step 8: Toss and Serve
steps.body: - Place your hot, double-fried chicken into a large mixing bowl ([**11:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=688s)). Pour the warm, glistening red glaze entirely over the crispy skin and toss vigorously until every surface is covered ([**11:28**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=688s)). Serve immediately while roaring hot ([**12:38**](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F1Bm01fBBpo&t=758s)).
